verdict.rationale: Docs confirm teams can add project-specific review guidelines via `.cursor/BUGBOT.md` (natural-language rules) and verify which rules were applied via `verbose=true`, plus natural-language effort-level tuning — but there is no evidence of AST-pattern rule definitions or linking external style guides directly into the reviewer's rule set. Missing for 10: AST/pattern-based rule authoring, support for linking/importing external style guide documents, and independent confirmation that custom BUGBOT.md rules are reliably enforced in practice.
